The rupee has fallen nearly 50% against the US dollar over the last 15 years, but does that really mean your savings have lost half their value? In this video, Aastha Khurana explains how a falling rupee impacts your savings, investments, retirement, and everyday expenses, and who is actually affected the most.
You'll also learn how imported inflation works, why foreign goals need a different investment strategy, and what practical steps you can take to protect your wealth in the long run.
